subject: Mystic Players Revival
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Margaret Petrella, president of the Mystic Players Revival, about the history, operations, and upcoming productions of the Medford-based community theater group.

items.title: History and Origin of Mystic Players Revival
items.summary: Margaret Petrella explained the origins of the Mystic Players Revival, which she founded as a non-profit to bring community theater back to Medford.

items.title: Margaret Petrella's Theater Background
items.summary: Margaret Petrella shared her personal background in musical theater, which began during her childhood in the Medford public school system.

items.title: The Mystic Cabaret Debut Production
items.summary: Margaret Petrella detailed how a Mass Cultural Council grant and support from local city officials helped secure funding and venue space at McGlynn Middle School for their debut production.

items.title: Auditioning and Casting Processes
items.summary: Margaret Petrella described using regional theater forums and social media to recruit directors and cast members from across New England.

items.title: Upcoming Shows and Events
items.summary: Margaret Petrella previewed upcoming performances, including an outdoor production of "Much Ado About Nothing" at the Condon Shell and a musical revue at Circle the Square.

items.title: Host Closing and Invitation to Local Candidates
items.summary: Host John Petrella concluded the program by inviting local political candidates and business owners to contact him to appear on future episodes.
